$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 \\ -14 & -16 & -2\end{aligned}],\,J=[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}],\,P=[\begin{aligned}1 & a & ∗ \\ 0 & b & ∗ \\ -2 & c & ∗\end{aligned}]

Consider the matrices above. Given that $A=PJ{P}^{-1}$ is a Jordan canonical decomposition of $A,$ find the value of $2a+c.$
